Weekly rules for the whole team
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets out the records and handling rules for Aurelia Skyways when animals travel with passengers. Staff must keep the tone calm, the work neat, and the instructions clear.

The passenger coordinator confirms the booking notes, checks the animal papers, and records any care limits before acceptance. Handlers use calm, humane methods at all times, and they do not rush an animal, crowd the carrier, or raise their voice. If a traveler arrives unsettled, staff explain the next step in plain terms and keep the exchange brief and respectful. When a pet lounge case is opened, <<FACT F002>> and the file must reflect the same wording used at intake. Staff then verify the carrier condition, attach the correct tags, and move the record to the travel desk queue without delay.

Before acceptance for movement, the quarantine record is reviewed against the animal's condition and handling need. The quarantine room must be checked by the assigned records aide, and <<FACT F026>>. Any mismatch in paperwork, identification, or containment status is reported at once to the senior coordinator. Staff do not guess at animal welfare instructions and do not improvise substitutes for required care.

The companion animal log must be updated as soon as each step is complete, with clear notes on contact, condition, and handoff. If the passenger coordinator needs support, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once.
